license_note: Same MoneyPuck licensing posture already documented in MONEYPUCK_TEAM_INGESTION_REPORT.md and research/goalie_intelligence/raw/provenance.json: free for non-commercial/research use, attribution required, RESEARCH/DEVELOPMENT DATA SOURCE only. Fetched directly (not scraped) from files MoneyPuck's own data.htm page explicitly lists for download, on the peter-tanner.com CDN host (which, unlike moneypuck.com's own edge, did not present a bot-detection/licensing gate for this request) -- identical source/host pattern already used and documented for the goalie game-by-game files.
schema_note: 157 columns, 5 situation rows per skater-game (all, 5on5, 5on4, 4on5, other). This project uses primarily 'all' (full-game totals, used as the SOG label and most features) and '5on4' (power-play-specific TOI/shot volume). No rush-attempt field and no linemate-identity field exist in this file (verified by full header audit) -- see PLAYER_SOG_FOUNDATION_REPORT.md Section A.
cross_validation: Every 'all'-situation gameId across all 4 seasons (188,863 rows total) matched a game_id already present in research/real_nhl_results/normalized_regular_season_games.jsonl, and every row's gameId type-digit was '02' (regular season) -- zero playoff contamination, zero unmatched games, same clean result as the goalie corpus.
note: Raw files preserved unchanged. Checksums verified with the same hashlib.sha256().hexdigest() helper as research/moneypuck_ingestion/checksums.py.
